node_schema.node_extension_rule: published chain nodes are immutable; new semantics use a new chain_version or a new operator on an existing node slot
node_schema.role_subclass_rule: node instances bind exactly one role subclass; allowed operator kinds and config schema come from that role subclass

base_node_schema.debug_subscription_rule: read-only observation; must not alter business result or control decision
base_node_schema.snapshot_subscription_rule: diagnostic only; snapshot must never become live runtime input
base_node_schema.statistics_rule: optional observability; must not enter decisions or payload
base_node_schema.debug_switch_rule: per-module/per-node debug/snapshot/dry_run/route_probe switch is dynamically live-updatable, audited, diagnostic-only, and must not affect business result, control decision, or payload
base_node_schema.dry_run_rule: every module supports dry-run with declared chain entry/exit or defaults to the full request/response chain; input is the correct payload fixture; no network, no live input, no fallback to live
base_node_schema.business_logic_rule: BaseNode carries no business logic; behavior comes from registered operators

plugin_schema.closure_rule: plugin owns node-local typed closure only; runtime kernel remains the only orchestrator
plugin_schema.config_validation_rule: operator config must validate against the node role subclass config_schema

wiring_schema.node_selection_rule: exactly one active_operator per node slot per compiled manifest
wiring_schema.edge_rule: edges are adjacent and fixed by chain_version

rules: group external interface equals NodeInstance interface
external data_in = entry data_in, external data_out = exit data_out
internal implementation replaceable when external interface unchanged
entry hooks run before operator in position order
exit hooks run after operator in position order
hooks cannot create a second lifecycle or shortcut nodes
hook failure enters the error chain explicitly; no fallback

v4_hub_chain.request_chain: server -> sse_in -> inbound -> chat_process(group) -> outbound -> compat -> provider_sse_out
v4_hub_chain.chat_process: supernode group with entry/exit hook queues

intake.payload_reread: forbidden; center never re-reads business payload to make decisions

error_center.v3_boundary: ErrorHandlingCenter remains ErrorErr06 client projection; V4 error center is intake/classify/audit only and never participates in provider policy or routing

route_exit.role: typed route control decision output boundary
route_exit.same_cycle_semantics: switch/cooldown/reroute are merged into the same payload cycle

payload_cycle.success_terminal: response entered client; next request starts a new cycle

dry_run.entry_exit: optional per chain; when undefined, run the full request or response chain
dry_run.input: correct payload fixture matching declared data_in kind

message_bus.failure_behavior: diagnostic error recorded; business path unchanged

completeness_gates.name: v3_resource_coverage
completeness_gates.rule: all 103 v3 resources classified with axis and operator_kind

completeness_gates.name: feature_operator_mapping
completeness_gates.rule: every v3 feature maps to >=1 operator; zero GAP

completeness_gates.name: reference_integrity
completeness_gates.rule: operator consumes/produces reference registered resources

completeness_gates.name: axis_boundary_machine_checkable
completeness_gates.rule: control/data/diagnostic invariants enforced by red tests

completeness_gates.name: manifest_selects_active_operator
completeness_gates.rule: compiled operator manifest selects exactly one active operator per node+scope

completeness_gates.name: node_immutability
completeness_gates.rule: published chain nodes cannot be inserted/reordered/renumbered

completeness_gates.name: plugin_closure
completeness_gates.rule: plugins own node-local closure only; no second lifecycle

completeness_gates.name: bus_not_decision_plane
completeness_gates.rule: subscribers cannot mutate control decisions or business outcome

completeness_gates.name: control_center_scope
completeness_gates.rule: register/consume/release isolated per scope; payload reconstruction forbidden

completeness_gates.name: control_record_required
completeness_gates.rule: every control_in/control_out writes an immutable ControlRecord; missing record fails

completeness_gates.name: debug_subscription_read_only
completeness_gates.rule: debug subscribers cannot mutate execution or decisions

completeness_gates.name: snapshot_subscription_diagnostic
completeness_gates.rule: node snapshots never enter live runtime input

completeness_gates.name: statistics_observability_only
completeness_gates.rule: statistics cannot affect decisions, payload, or business truth

completeness_gates.name: node_graph_machine_controlled
completeness_gates.rule: node graph edges are machine contracts; code-level conversions/subscriptions must resolve to declared edges

completeness_gates.name: data_control_flow_separated
completeness_gates.rule: data flow edges and control flow edges are separate edge kinds; control never enters data axis

completeness_gates.name: debug_relations_v3_locked
completeness_gates.rule: v4 debug subscription relations must not relax v3 anchored debug resource relations

completeness_gates.name: node_numbering_contract
completeness_gates.rule: node_id encodes order+function and is immutable after publication

completeness_gates.name: group_node_interface_equivalence
completeness_gates.rule: group external interface equals NodeInstance interface; parent pipeline treats group as one node

completeness_gates.name: pipeline_explicit_lifecycle
completeness_gates.rule: every chain has explicit single-entry single-terminal nodes+edges and explicit error path

completeness_gates.name: standard_test_semantics
completeness_gates.rule: every published node/group/chain has its standard test surface before anchored

completeness_gates.name: hub_chain_fixed
completeness_gates.rule: v4 hub request chain fixed: server -> sse_in -> inbound -> chat_process(group) -> outbound -> compat -> provider_sse_out

completeness_gates.name: sse_boundary_only
completeness_gates.rule: SSE is transport boundary only; internal data plane is JSON semantic; SSE in/out coupling forbidden

completeness_gates.name: hook_queue_contract
completeness_gates.rule: node entry/exit hook queues are machine declared, ordered, effect-classified, no second lifecycle

completeness_gates.name: module_debug_switch_contract
completeness_gates.rule: per-module/per-node debug/snapshot/dry-run/route_probe switches are dynamically live-updatable, audited, diagnostic-only, and never affect business path, payload, MetadataCenter, or error chain

completeness_gates.name: error_center_classify_audit_only
completeness_gates.rule: error center receives typed error facts + payload hash + typed context from any node/operator/hook; it classifies and audits only; route operation, retry/cooldown/reroute execution, provider local policy, and payload rewrite are forbidden

completeness_gates.name: route_exit_vr_owned
completeness_gates.rule: route control exit is VR-owned typed decision output; switch/cooldown/reroute exit here; error center cannot route; route exit never patches payload or writes provider/client wire

completeness_gates.name: payload_cycle_contract
completeness_gates.rule: payload cycle starts at request send, ends at response-into-client (next request = new cycle) or error terminal; switch/cooldown/reroute merge into the same cycle; original request payload immutable

completeness_gates.name: dry_run_chain_contract
completeness_gates.rule: every module supports dry-run with declared chain entry/exit or defaults to the full request/response chain; input is the correct payload fixture; no network, no live input, no provider/client wire, no fallback to live
